site.description: Snap what you want to let go, let family say what they want, and assign each item to the right person.

home.eyebrow: For clearing a home, garage, or estate
home.headline: Decide together who takes what — no spreadsheets or WhatsApp chaos
home.subhead: You snap photos of items on your phone. Family and friends say what they want. You see who’s interested and assign each item.
home.hasLinkDetail: Open it in your browser — no account needed to vote.
home.howSubtitle: Once your list is ready, sharing is the easy part.
home.step1Body: Give it a clear name (“Mom’s clear-out”, “Garage to empty”). Group by room or type: keep, donate, sell.
home.step2Body: One photo, room, and type — that’s it. No long descriptions: people see the picture right away.
home.step3Body: Copy the link or send it on WhatsApp, SMS, or email. Everyone lands on the same page, phone or computer.
home.step4Body: On each item, people tap Yes or No. No sign-up required to vote.
home.step5Body: You see who said yes. Assign each item to the right person — no more endless “who wants the sofa?”
home.shareMockHint: Same link for everyone — no need to invite people one by one.
home.shareSpotlightTitle: Building the list is the work. Sharing takes seconds.
home.shareSpotlightBody: When your items are online, just send the link. People vote when it suits them, without bothering you for every object.
home.shareSpotlightPoint2: No app to install for voters
home.shareSpotlightPoint3: You stay in control: you assign at the end
home.pathOrganizerBody: You create the list, add photos, share the link, and assign items when voting is done.
home.pathGuestBody: Open the link you received (SMS, WhatsApp, email). You’ll see items one by one and can say what you’re interested in.
home.pathGuestHint: Paste the link in Safari or Chrome
home.reassure1: 📱 Everything from your phone — including photos.
home.reassure2: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Built for families: grandparents, kids, neighbors.
home.reassure3: 🔒 You decide who gets what; votes help, they don’t replace your choice.
home.imgAltPhoto: Adding an item with photo and emojis
home.imgAltVote: Voting screen: Yes and No buttons

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your lists on all your devices.
login.error: Something went wrong ({error}). Please try again.
login.voterBody: Open it directly — no account needed to vote.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn’t exist anymore. You’ll be redirected to the home.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.body: An unexpected error occurred. You can retry or go back to home.

tour.stepWelcomeBody: A quick tour shows you how to add items and share the link with family.
tour.stepTitleBody: Tap to edit it. Pick a clear name, e.g. “Mom’s clear-out”.
tour.stepTabsBody: Items: your photos. Share: the link to send. Results: who said yes and who gets each item.
tour.stepAddBody: Take a photo of a new item, or pick from your inventory if you already have photos.
tour.stepShareBody: Send this link on WhatsApp, SMS, or email. Everyone lands on the same page to say yes or no.
tour.stepResultsBody: When people have voted, you see who’s interested and can assign each item to the right person.
tour.readyAddTitle: Ready to add your first item?
tour.readyAddBody: We’ll walk you through a photo and a few details step by step.
tour.itemWelcomeBody: We’ll add a photo and a few details. You can add more items later.
tour.itemPhotoBody: Take a photo with the camera or pick one from your gallery.
tour.itemAfterPhotoBody: When your photo is ready, tap Continue below to choose the room.
tour.itemRoomBody: Where is the item? Living room, basement, bedroom, etc.
tour.itemCategoryBody: Pick a category (furniture, appliance, decor…) to stay organized.
tour.itemTagsBody: Add personal keywords if you like — e.g. “Florian’s desk”.
tour.itemSaveBody: A name is optional. When you’re done, tap the button to add the item to your list.

pwa.title: Add the app to your home screen
pwa.subtitle: One tap to open — like a real app, without going through the browser each time.
pwa.iosStep1: Open {name} in Safari (not Chrome or a messaging app).
pwa.iosStep2: Tap the Share button at the bottom (square icon with an arrow pointing up).
pwa.iosStep3: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then confirm with “Add”.
pwa.iosHint: You’ll find {name} as an app on your phone.
pwa.androidStep1: Open the ⋮ menu at the top right in Chrome.
pwa.androidStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.androidStep3: Confirm — the icon will appear on your home screen.
